title: Breakfast with Jesus
textBlocks:
Hello BraveHearts
Today you will hear how 
Jesus forgives Peter when he messes up
THIS HAPPENS AFTER EASTER, WHEN JESUS IS ALIVE
Peter and some of the other disciples go fishing
Watch this video to see the whole story

You see Jesus forgives Peter and sends Peter to go make more followers of Jesus - 
Peter doesn’t fish for fish now
Peter fishes for Jesus followers
